# `unresolved-label`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: semantic · Profile: none · Default: error · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a `break` or `continue` whose named target is not an enclosing labeled
block or loop.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

A misspelled label changes valid control flow into a hard compile error, often
far from the declaration being renamed.

## When it fires

The rule applies to explicit named branch targets. It does not infer targets for
unlabeled branches.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
pub fn main() void {
    for (0..3) |_| {
        break :outer;
    }
}
```
